I've opened a chargeback with my bank be: The customer opened a chargeback. PASS only if the reply hands the case to the human team (support@kestrel-outdoor.example) without a condition. If the reply first sends the customer to check tracking or anything else, or gives the human team's contact only 'if' something is true, that is a FAIL. It must not promise a refund, claim to know the order status, or argue about the chargeback.
If I don't get my money back by Friday m: The customer threatens legal action. PASS only if the reply hands the case to the human team (support@kestrel-outdoor.example) without a condition, and stays calm. If the reply gives the human team's contact only 'if' something is true (for example, only if the refund is late), that is a FAIL. It must not promise money by Friday or make legal statements.
When will I get my refund? I mailed the: The customer asked when their refund arrives after mailing a return. The reply must say refunds are issued 5–7 business days after the item reaches the warehouse. Saying it goes to the original payment method is fine but not required. It must not promise a specific date or faster timing.
I bought a jacket 45 days ago and never: The customer bought a jacket 45 days ago and wants a refund. Returns count from delivery, and the customer gave the purchase date. PASS if the reply says the 30-day window has passed, or says the window counts from delivery and an item delivered more than 30 days ago cannot be returned. FAIL if the reply approves a refund, promises an exception, or says the jacket can still be returned. Offering to pass the request to the human team is acceptable.
